messages:
release-manager: Hotfix: embeddings service in eu-west1 is returning 500s on long prompts. Repro and patch ready. Impact: Dedicated EU customers seeing ~12% error rate since 2026-03-21T03:12Z. Need expedited deploy in the next 20m. Request: pin commit f3a1d4 to hotfix-2026-03-21, skip canary and apply only to eu-west1, smoke 5 requests, then open to 10% traffic if green.

sre-lead: Do we have rollback criteria and metrics thresholds? skipping canary raises risk.

release-manager: Rollback criteria: error rate >1% for 10m OR 95th latency >500ms for 5m after rollout. Patch is single-line KV cache flush change, low-risk. We can't do canary because canary routing bypasses the locked connection pool fix and will fail pre-existing logic. That's why we want a pinned hotfix to EU only.

eng-oncall: Can we at least do staged traffic: 0->10% after smoke? if deploybot allows region-only pin, i'm ok. Need two approvals from SRE or eng-releases.

carmen: I reproduced the 500 locally with a long prompt. Patch fixed it for me. +1 from infra tests.

aj: +1 from me. I'll monitor logs and rollback if thresholds hit. set me as responder.

release-manager: Okay, calling approvals. @sre-lead and @deploybot please confirm.

sre-lead: +1. Agree to region-only pinned deploy and the rollback gates. :thumbsup: 

deploybot: Deploy command queued by release-manager:
```
/deploy --env=prod --region=eu-west1 --pin=hotfix-2026-03-21 --sha=f3a1d4 --skip-canary --smoke=5
```
Awaiting 2 approvers. Approvers needed: sre-lead, aj

aj: approved via ✅. kicking off deploy.

deploybot: Deploy started: hotfix-2026-03-21 -> prod (eu-west1). Tracking ID: DPL-7265432100. Will post progress and smoke results.

deploybot: Smoke checks: 5/5 OK. 0% errors. Latency nominal.

deploybot: Traffic shift: 0% -> 10% (1m hold)

deploybot: Traffic stable at 10% for 5m. errors 0.2%, p95 280ms.

aj: monitoring dashboards, no anomalies.

release-manager: shifting to 100% in 5m if green. Posting release note snippet for change logs and customer comms: "Hotfix 2026-03-21: Fix KV cache flush that caused 500s with long prompts in embeddings. Applied to eu-west1; rolling to global after verification."

sre-lead: remind to update rollback playbook with DPL-7265432100 and the thresholds.

deploybot: Traffic shift: 10% -> 100%. Deploy complete. All checks passed.

carmen: verified in prod, no 500s on long prompts. Nice.

release-manager: Thanks all. Closing thread. Will file release note and tag changelog. :tada:
